name: Glace Bay
text: Glace Bay is a community in the eastern part of the Cape Breton Regional Municipality in Nova Scotia, Canada. It forms part of the general area referred to as Industrial Cape Breton. Formerly an incorporated town (1901–1995), the municipal government in Glace Bay was dissolved and the community was amalgamated into the larger regional municipality.

depictions.name: Glace Bay
depictions.text: Glace Bay is a community in Nova Scotia, Canada. During the mid-18th century, it was a largely uninhabited region, with its mountaineous terrain primarily populated by deer and beavers. Glace Bay also possessed a hunting lodge at the time, which was initially occupied by gang members, before being freed from their control and then renovated by the Templar Shay Cormac.
